patch.lastPrompt: You are an expert C++ to Rust migration engineer. Read the following C++ source code: --- Source (/workspace/dataset/immer/tests/test11.cpp) --- #include <immer/vector.hpp> #include <iostream> #include <string> int main(int argc, char* argv[]) { int n = (argc > 1) ? std::stoi(argv[1]) : 11; auto v = immer::vector<int>{}; for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) { v = v.push_back(i + 1); } auto sum = 0; for (auto x : v) { sum += x; } std::cout << sum << std::endl; auto v2 = immer::vector<int>{}; for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); ++i) { v2 = v2.push_back(v[i] * 2); } sum = 0; for (auto x : v2) { sum += x; } std::cout << sum << std::endl; return 0; } /* ============================== TEST CASE EXAMPLES (Top 5) ============================== --- Example 1 --- Input Args: {"n": "0"} Program Output: 0 0 --- Example 2 --- Input Args: {"n": "1"} Program Output: 1 2 --- Example 3 --- Input Args: {"n": "2"} Program Output: 3 6 --- Example 4 --- Input Args: {"n": "3"} Program Output: 6 12 --- Example 5 --- Input Args: {"n": "4"} Program Output: 10 20 */ --- Requirements: 1. **Environment**: Write pure Rust using the 2021 edition. Code must compile with `rustc` or as a Cargo project. 2. **CLI arguments**: The Rust binary must accept exactly the same command-line arguments as the C++ binary (same names, defaults, and required fields). Parse args via `std::env::args()`. 3. **Logic and output**: Algorithm logic, numeric precision, and string formatting must exactly match the C++ source. `println!` output must be byte-for-byte identical to `std::cout` output. 4. **Zero external dependencies**: Do NOT use any crates from crates.io (only `std`). Forbidden crates for this repo: none. Implement all functionality from scratch using the standard library. 5. **Project structure**: Create a complete Cargo project in `/output`. Organize library code into modules. Place the entry test file `test11.rs` in the package root `/output`. 6. **Black-box implementation**: Do not read the C++ library source. Infer behavior from the interface, then re-implement using `std`. 7. **Output**: - Create and implement library files inside `/output`. - Save the entry file to `/output/test11.rs`. - Compile and produce an executable at `/output/test11.rs` (by running `rustc test11.rs` or `cargo build --release`). Hint: `/workspace/dataset/test11_executable` is the compiled C++ binary — use it to debug with any arguments.
